Raga: Suddha Bhairav
Vocal: Naad Sindhu Athah Re Man
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Naad Sindhu Athah Re Man”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
